Thanks for flagging. Quick thoughts after reviewing the comp model:

- We have limited band flexibility at the moment; moving base to $168k would require a band exception for the role (we can do, but it needs VP sign-off).
- Approving a one-time sign-on is faster from a governance perspective; I can approve up to $15k from comp desk for a high-priority hire without finance escalation. Anything above that requires finance and VP approval.
- If the hiring manager can commit to start date within 30 days, I can also approve a 6-month retention bonus clause (vested on 6 months) to be added to package instead of pushing base.

Recommendation (fastest path for candidate who prefers Redwood): offer $160k base + $15k sign-on + 6-month retention bonus of $5k contingent on 6-month employment. That keeps run-rate low and is more likely to be approved quickly.
